title: EvalVSN: reinforcement learning agents in a cross-layer stack for video over wireless sensor networks
description: Material that accompanies the article “Reinforcement Learning Agents in a Cross-Layer Stack for Forest Fire Video Surveillance over Wireless Sensor Networks”, by Mohammed Yassine Baziz, Larbi Sekhri and Bouabdellah Kechar, under revision in Sensors (MDPI), manuscript sensors-4703240. Version v2.0.1 corresponds to the revised manuscript. It contains the code of the EvalVSN tool, the modules added to or modified in ns-2.35, the simulation and measurement scripts, the results of each simulation and the tools that produce the tables and figures of the article; the README gives, for each table and each figure drawn from the data, the command that reproduces it. The source videos, taken from the FLAME 2 dataset, are not redistributed. Licenses: the EvalVSN tool and the scripts under the GNU GPL 3.0; in the ns-2 modules, the files written by the authors under the GNU GPL 2.0 or later, and the files derived from ns-2 and AOMDV under their original license; data and tables under CC BY 4.0; the images decoded from a FLAME 2 video keep the terms of that dataset; the Twemoji pictograms are under CC BY 4.0 (Twitter, Inc. and other contributors).
